sizeGuide.title: Size guide
sizeGuide.intro: Two ways to find your size: the chart, or — more reliable — measure a t-shirt you already wear.
sizeGuide.chartIntro: Garment measurements, laid flat, in centimetres.
sizeGuide.measureIntro: Lay a t-shirt that fits you flat and measure it. No tape measure needed — a ruler or an A4 sheet (21 cm) will do.
sizeGuide.measureChestHelp: Armpit seam to armpit seam, laid flat.
sizeGuide.measureLengthHelp: From the top of the shoulder to the hem.
sizeGuide.measureSleeveHelp: From the shoulder seam to the cuff.
sizeGuide.resultBody: Based on your measurements, size {size} should fit like yours.
sizeGuide.resultBetween: You're between sizes. Take {size} for a closer fit, {larger} for roomier.
sizeGuide.resultNone: Enter at least the chest measurement.
sizeGuide.outOfRange: That's outside our size run — message us on WhatsApp.
sizeGuide.saved: Size saved for your next visits.
